newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures cut gain after bond close.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures cut gain after bond close.

text.p: July 1 - U.S. stock index futures trimmed back early gains following the 1400 CDT close of debt futures trade. September S&P futures continue to struggle above 900.00, but could be gathering strength for decisive push through the level, traders said. Financial markets await Wednesday's conclusion of the two-day FOMC meeting.
